drums.tags: Funk rock instrumental. A clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and palm muting. An electric bass guitar follows the guitar rhythm with a bright, mid-forward tone, emphasizing the root and octave. The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hats. The tempo is 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement features a call-and-response dynamic between the guitar and bass, with occasional slides and ghost notes in the bass line. The production is dry with minimal reverb, focusing on the rhythmic interplay of the strings.

bass.tags: Industrial techno. 130 BPM, 4/4 time signature. A distorted, resonant kick drum provides a heavy, saturated low-end pulse. A metallic, percussive synth sequence runs in sixteenth notes with a high-pass filter sweep. A gritty, overdriven bass synth mirrors the kick's rhythm with short, staccato decays. Industrial foley sounds, including metallic clangs and mechanical whirs, are processed with short room reverb and rhythmic delay. A sharp, white-noise snare hits on beats 2 and 4, layered with a digital clap. Closed hi-hats play a consistent eighth-note pattern with occasional sixteenth-note rolls. Dark, atmospheric pads with slow attack and long release provide a dissonant harmonic layer in the background. The track features a minimalist arrangement focused on rhythmic texture and timbral evolution through filter modulation and distortion saturation.

[sixteenth-note synth sequence enters with filter sweep]
